[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] [[Perdition Rock]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear Perdition Rock in the [[Ring of Fire Island Chain|Ring of Fire Islands]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 250 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
